unit_notes: Machine utilisation *fractions* at 60 s (the '_percent' column names are a misnomer in this mirror), aggregated to 300 s; scaled by a nominal 96-core / 384 GB machine.
wallclock_anchor: arbitrary fixed offset - source timestamps are relative to the trace epoch, so hour/day-of-week labels carry a constant unknown phase shift
burst_labels: heuristic (MAD rule on first difference, k=6, refractory=6)
